entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something. I'm just so confused by this whole process. It's a helmet.
I can certainly help you look into that. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, yes, I think so. It's VF88761. I just... I don't know if I'm doing this right. The website had so many options.

No problem at all, I've got your order right here. It's for the AeroPro Helmet. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. The box is still unopened. It's just... the color. It looked different online and it just doesn't match my bike at all. I know it sounds silly, but I'm overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can help. It's not silly at all; getting the right gear is important, especially for safety and feeling good on your ride. Let me just check the policy for you. I see it was delivered 14 days ago.
Is that bad? I wasn't sure what the rules were. I just don't want to be stuck with it.
Not at all. According to our policy, you have 90 days to return an item, so you are well within the window. Since the box is unopened, we can definitely process a full refund for that helmet.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll issue the refund. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help, David. Thank you!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
